findings.title: order() applied to non-flex item has no effect
findings.body: @include order(2) is added to .extra-info-wrapper at the top level of the selector, but the CSS in this file does not make .extra-info-wrapper (or any of its ancestors inside this PR) a flex container, and the property only takes effect on flex items. Consequence: the rule is dead code; the author appears to intend for this element to be reordered within a flex row, but the layout will not change at all, so the rendered topic header ordering is unchanged from before this PR. Either the parent (e.g. #topic-title) must be turned into a flex container, or the rule should be removed.

findings.title: Invalid -ms-align-items property in align-items mixin
findings.body: The align-items mixin emits `-ms-align-items: $alignment;`, which is not a valid CSS property. The Microsoft/IE10 syntax for alignment is `-ms-flex-align`, which is already included on the preceding line. Browsers silently ignore unknown property names, so this line is harmless dead output, but it is misleading to future readers and clutters the compiled CSS. It should be removed.
